title: Ocean Scene 8 — Find and Follow Directions
purpose: Following two-step directions and finding animals from location clues.

sentenceModels: Find the crab under the rock.
Point to the octopus behind the coral.
Show me the starfish on the sand.
First point to the turtle, then point to the yellow fish.

adultSupport.focus: Use one-step and two-step instructions with clear spatial clues.
starterPrompts: Can you find the crab under the rock?
Show me the starfish on the sand.
Which animal is next to the seaweed?
expansionPrompts: First point to the seahorse, then point to the turtle.
Find the animal behind the coral and then the animal under the rock.

visualAudit: One turtle swimming in the middle.
One seahorse next to tall seaweed on the left.
One crab clearly under a rock on the lower-left.
One starfish on the sand near the bottom centre.
One octopus behind coral on the right and three yellow fish at the top-right.
